name: kanban_integration
description: Kanban board integration for mem20: task tracking, workflow visualization, automated status updates from roadmap phases, and cross-project progress monitoring.

name.name: Phase 1: Audit existing kanban-mcp code at /opt/mem20/mem20/kanban-mcp/
Phase 2: Integrate kanban with mem20 roadmap system (auto-sync phases to cards)
Phase 3: Add CLI and web dashboard views
Phase 4: Cross-project progress monitoring and reporting
Phase 5: Automated task creation from roadmap phase changes

retroactive_audit.notes: Phase 1 (audit kanban-mcp code) completed. Phase 2 (integrate with mem20 roadmaps) in progress. Phases 3-5 planned.
